Interstellar

A slow descent toward a black hole. Sound on.

Past the edge of the map

A black hole bends the light behind it into a ring. Rangers and the Endurance circle the disk. Scroll to move closer.

Time slows near the edge

The closer you orbit, the slower your clock runs compared with everyone left behind.

A river of fire

Gas spirals inward, heats up, and glows brighter than every star around it.

A door in space

A wormhole folds two places together. Find the glowing sphere beside the black hole, or fly in with the button.
